tasks.description: In `orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py`, add `_write_brc_history(worktree_path, pipeline_id, phase, identifier)` that retrieves BRC messages from `get_message_store().get_messages(pipeline_id, limit=10000)`, filters to CONSENSUS_* types, formats as chronological markdown, writes to `.egg-state/brc-history/{identifier}-{phase}.md`. Call at line ~6734 (before existing _commit_statefiles_to_worktree) and at line ~6433 (PR phase block). No-op when store is empty.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: After each phase with BRC activity, `.egg-state/brc-history/{identifier}-{phase}.md` exists with chronological BRC messages. Empty store produces no file.

tasks.description: In `orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py:_build_pr_body()`, add '## BRC Consensus Summary' section. Retrieve messages via `get_message_store().get_messages(pipeline.id, limit=10000)`, filter to CONSENSUS_* types, group by phase, show per-phase agent roles, proposal/ACK/NACK/confirmation counts, and whether consensus was reached. Cap at ~2000 chars. Omit section when no BRC messages. Insert before 'Authored-by: egg' footer.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: PR body includes BRC Consensus Summary when BRC messages exist, omitted when none. Summary stays under 2000 chars.

tasks.description: Add tests in `orchestrator/tests/test_auto_pr.py` for `_write_brc_history` (messages present → correct file path and content; empty store → no file) and `_build_pr_body` (messages present → BRC summary section in body; empty store → no BRC section). Mock `get_message_store` with `unittest.mock.patch`.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All new tests pass covering normal, empty store, and PR body scenarios.

pr.title: Include BRC consensus context in git history and PR body
pr.description:
Writes per-phase BRC message history to `.egg-state/brc-history/{identifier}-{phase}.md`
at phase boundaries, and adds a concise BRC Consensus Summary section to the PR body.
This deterministically preserves agent communication context for code review reference,
replacing the non-deterministic pattern where agent-committed review files sometimes
appeared in `.egg-state/agent-outputs/`.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: test_auto_pr.py tests for _write_brc_history file creation, content format, and empty store handling
- Automated: test_auto_pr.py tests for _build_pr_body with/without BRC messages
- Manual: Run a pipeline with concurrent agents and verify .egg-state/brc-history/ files appear on the branch and PR body has BRC summary
